status: PROVEN STATIC for the set/clear of bit 9 around the RT byte; the predicate itself is not reversed
code: 0x1e0cee2  r1 = b[sp+1093] (u)      ; candidate +0x0d, the RT byte
0x1e0ceec  b[sp+1093] = r0            ; the RT byte is written back
0x1e0cefe  r4 = r1                    ; else bit 9 stays cleared
finding: This is the earliest creator of mask bit 0x200. The value the analog RT byte (candidate+0x0d) produces through 0x1e0a426 is tested: non-zero sets bit 9 in the candidate mask, zero explicitly clears it via the literal 0xfffffdff. The same call result is written back as the RT byte itself.
consequence: Bit 9 is therefore DERIVED from the RT byte and is not copied from the controller report - consistent with the live finding that the Xbox report has no digital RT bit.
not_proven: the inside of 0x1e0a426 - threshold, scaling or pass-through is not established
the value domain that makes r0 non-zero
